scope: All 116 field-guide topics and 561 planning/UI content items. Initial findings are retained; resolution refers to integrated cases or rewritten content. UI IDs include historical line positions, not current source citations.

field_guide.finding: The overview has only abstract boundaries. Walk one question, Retail Everyday fee, through authenticated request, permitted passage, cited draft and review result; identify each artifact by ID.
Show one POST body, authenticated identity, HTTP status and response body; contrast a 200 unresolved result with transport failure and denied scope.
Provide exact valid, missing-product and denied request/response payloads. Existing advice names outcomes without showing the schema or values that distinguish them.
Show a fictional route table with model revision, allowed region, remaining token budget and fallback outcome. Include a fallback rejected for disallowed region rather than silently selected.
Existing shed example does not contain the rule text or actual boundary. Show a short source with a numeric height limit and protected-area exception, bad split, repaired chunks and resulting answer.

The live cosine calculator supplies vectors (1,2,0) and (2,3,1), a computed score and invalid-vector handling. Keep the text's paraphrase-versus-ward failure; mark vectors as toy values rather than outputs of a named model.

Show a query vector, three passage vectors, exact neighbour IDs and one approximate omission. Compute recall against the exact list under an explicit access filter; current example merely says compare.
PL-104 is a concrete query but there is no corpus or returned result. Supply PL-104 and PL-140 passage text and the expected exact-code match, plus a paraphrase lexical search misses.

Runtime-tested fusion code supplies two explicit rankings, reciprocal-rank arithmetic and a deterministic tie assertion. Preserve this worked example; optionally add a unequal-ranking case to make the ranking change visible.
The fifty-to-five funnel is a workload count, not a worked rerank. Show a three-document shortlist, initial order, reranker order and relevant ID; contrast with that ID missing from all candidates.
Monday source versus Friday output is a concrete failure only. Show the exact question, supplied sentence, correct cited output and incorrect output so readers can apply the support check.
Give one source, two candidate answers and a fact-level rubric. Show human and judge labels with reasons, including the verbose unsupported answer incorrectly preferred by the judge.

The all-positive failure is understandable but lacks labelled cases. Supply a small answerable/unanswerable table, predicted routes and confusion counts; include a missing-policy question that must refer.

The student-fee source and universal-waiver claim are specific inputs with the required distinction stated. Preserve this counterexample; a three-label table would deepen it but is not needed to make this existing example concrete.
Use an invented identifier in the exact input and show the blocked outbound request plus sanitized trace. Current phone-number narrative does not show transformed values or the detector miss case.
Show the original holiday collection question, first query/result, targeted second query/result and final supported answer. Add the precise stop outcome after repeated empty results.
Show initial irrelevant passage, quality verdict, rewritten query and replacement evidence; include a useful passage incorrectly rejected. Current example only names the procedure.

Use an explicit source date, generated different date and self-check verdict versus reviewed verdict. If showing trained Self-RAG tokens, verify that method; otherwise label the example a generic self-check, as current text correctly distinguishes.
Show two exact questions, selected routes, required evidence IDs and outcomes. Include a holiday question misrouted to one-source lookup and a fixed-long-path comparison on the same cases.
Show two short source sentences, extracted entity-relation triples and a question that joins them. Trace the answer to both sources; delete one relation and show stale-summary failure.

Provide the complete heading and pronoun-dependent passage, then identify token spans pooled after contextual encoding. Show how this differs from independently embedding a chunk; do not invent measured model vectors.
Show original passage and exact added context sentence as separate fields. Contrast a correct North ward prefix with an invented South ward prefix and the resulting wrong-scope retrieval.
Show a small query-token/document-token similarity matrix and max-per-query-token aggregation, with actual score arithmetic. An exact form-code story alone does not demonstrate late interaction.
Show original query, hypothetical answer, retrieved real passage and final source-backed answer. Give conflicting fictional and real dates to demonstrate why the hypothetical answer is not evidence.

The actual compound collection/missed-collection question is decomposed into two distinct searches, with a concrete missing-half failure. Preserve this; explicitly writing both rewritten strings would improve presentation.
Show child and parent IDs with exact rule and exception text. Trace child match to parent expansion and final qualified answer; include the context-budget consequence with explicit counts.
Give the North and South questions, distinct actual days, cached scope/revision and hit-or-miss decisions. Existing strings expose a risk but do not show valid and invalid reuse outcomes.

Provide an explicitly illustrative comparison table on identical routine/exception cases with quality, latency and cost. Show a route that saves cost but fails an exception; avoid inferring price from parameter count.
Show exact cache key fields, source-v1 Monday result, source-v2 Tuesday result and expected miss after revision. Current narrative does not expose the key or state transition.
Replace only-count illustration with input IDs [A,B,C] and returned IDs [A,A,C]; show duplicate A, missing B and unresolved run. Keep the larger-count warning as context.

Show a concrete request destination and surrounding exporter destination, identifying which payload leaves the host. Add an all-local alternative and an observable verification artifact without claiming a real deployment.
Show three named stages and typed outputs, then an automatic retry after an already-completed referral. Show the stored operation ID that prevents a second effect.

The supplied Python schema and actual Friday/north answer demonstrate shape and citation-ID checks passing while factual support may fail. Preserve this concrete code; its syntax-checked status is accurately limited.

Supply a two-row/two-column source table and the erroneous flattened extraction, then correct records with page references. The current wrong-ward narrative omits the values needed to see the layout error.
Show input case IDs and runner output with one missing/error row, then gate failure after an injected wrong result. Generic instructions to verify completeness do not demonstrate that check.
Give a small request/span table with parent IDs, source IDs and status. Show the missing retrieval span and corrected safe trace; raw passage capture should not be treated as required.
16/20 maps to approximately 0.584-0.919 in prose, executable code and interactive calculator. Inputs, output, arithmetic and sampling limits are concrete.
Zero failures in 60 maps to approximate 5% and exact 4.87% upper bounds, with independence and common-probability assumptions. Preserve the numerical example.
8 TP,4 FP,2 FN,6 TN yield 67% precision,80% recall,40% FPR, with formulas and interactive calculator. Concrete denominators and zero-denominator handling already exist.
Executable case expects rule and exception but returns rule, producing hit rate 1 and recall 0.5. This directly demonstrates the distinction; retain it.
Five independent 0.95 stages produce 0.95^5 approximately 77.4%, alongside correct conditional-probability qualification. Concrete arithmetic is already present.
Five actual scores 81,84,80,83,82 produce mean 82 and range 80-84. The explicit warning that range is not a significance test supplies the interpretation boundary.
Observed 0.85 and expected 0.65 agreement produce kappa 0.571 with shown substitution. A reviewer contingency table could explain expected agreement further, but this is already concrete arithmetic.

96/100 development versus 82/100 untouched evaluation provides actual labelled denominators and separate outcomes. Preserve it; a case-lineage example would address split mechanics rather than replace this example.
Show a small run manifest with actual fictional dataset, model, prompt and rubric revisions. Compare two runs and identify the one changed field; distinguish recorded settings from determinism.
Runtime-tested bytes North ward Monday versus Friday produce different SHA-256 digests. The exact input bytes, check and output exist, with the correct limit that hashes do not establish truth.
Name a fixture value, expected gate result, deliberate changed value and exact failed assertion. Current alter-a-known-result wording gives no reproducible mutation or output.

Supply paired A/B scores for several question IDs, one resampled ID sequence, corresponding mean difference and a seeded resampling interval. Keep pairs together and state interval method; no observations or interval are currently shown.

Work one prespecified design with actual baseline/variance, meaningful effect, alpha, power and computed sample requirement. Distinguish paired and independent designs; do not add a universal five-point sample count.

Show an item-by-reviewer rating table with a missing rating, declared nominal or ordinal distance and computed observed/expected disagreement. Verify the alpha result independently; formula alone does not teach its inputs.
100 predictions at 90% with 70 correct explicitly yields 70% observed frequency. The event, denominator, output and uncertainty caveat are concrete.

Give two traffic windows with task counts and per-task error counts. Show changed traffic without changed within-task performance, then a true within-task degradation, so readers can distinguish them.

Show a short allocation log with arm, selection probability and reward at each step, plus the policy update. Contrast adaptive rewards with a naive fixed-arm mean; current text supplies no actual allocation.

Show a fixed-sample plan, several interim looks and the invalid early stop. Contrast a prespecified permitted look rule or valid sequential output; do not imply ordinary 95% intervals permit unlimited looks.
Give matched question IDs and A/B results, then a confounded comparison using different easy/hard task mixes. Demonstrate why the aggregate improvement does not identify a component effect.
Show three actual answers that disagree on day, and three identically wrong answers. Distinguish wording changes from fact changes and compare against a stated source sentence.
Six-of-eight counts are concrete but do not show the claims being classified. Supply a source sentence and supported/contradicted/unresolved claim table with reasons so readers can perform the check.
Live calculator has explicit vectors, cosine output and invalid-input handling. Preserve it and the negation/number limitation; the toy vectors are not a factual-equivalence measure.

Define one concrete harmful outcome and a controlled pair of otherwise equivalent cases. Show subgroup denominators and results; distinguish an illustrative scoped disparity from a universal fairness conclusion.

Give three fictional configurations with comparable cost, quality and latency values. Identify the dominated option and non-dominated alternatives, with a safety constraint that excludes an otherwise cheap option.

Provide a synthetic malicious document instruction, permitted task, attempted forbidden tool call and observed denial/no-effect result. Record one regression case without calling attack-set success a population rate.

Show an actual short calendar record with source ID/revision, derived question and reviewed expected answer. Label source data and evaluation case separately; existing description only names the distinction.
Give one question, relevant source ID, actual ranked result IDs and the wrong-ward result to reject. The top-level topic currently offers only a relevant-topic caution.
Show exact source, prompt input and a good versus fabricated JSON answer, including unresolved output when evidence is absent. Current valid-JSON warning has no actual payload.
Show a compact evaluation report with named cases, outcomes, one error, one missing output and the resulting release decision. Explain why the same mean score can conceal a blocked critical case.
Use one small observation table to choose a proportion interval versus a paired comparison. Show the question, denominator and relevant calculation; a navigation list of methods is insufficient.
Actual North ward/green-bin/Monday case dictionary provides ID, question, required facts, source ID, answerability and split. Concrete absent-holiday failure complements it.
Give two actual candidate answers and a row-by-row rubric for ward, colour, day and invented exception. Record reviewer labels and one resolved disagreement, not only instructions to calibrate.
Show case IDs grouped by originating document/conversation, proposed leaky split and corrected grouped split. Name which examples can guide prompts and which remain untouched.
Show an original question, two generated paraphrases and their shared source lineage. Mark the duplicate or leakage rejection and one independently reviewed accepted case.
Supply two small run manifests and matched per-case outputs including a failure and missing response. Compute a comparison while preserving every input ID; current text only describes the workflow.

Wilson calculator supplies 16/20 and actual interval output, alongside the prediction-probability versus sample-uncertainty distinction. The topic is not wholly abstract; preserve the existing interactive evidence.
Walk an actual user task through proposed tool arguments, application authorization, execution result and final answer. Show a tool failure that must remain failure despite a fluent final message.
Show one request with healthy HTTP delivery but wrong-source answer, its trace/source revision and resulting incident action. This should visibly distinguish service health from answer quality.
Provide a fictional workload table with context/output lengths, concurrency, measured memory and latency. Show a configuration that loads but fails the stated request budget under load.
Use one input/desired output to contrast changing prompt text and changing trainable weights, with a common held-out comparison. Current distinction is accurate but has no visible transformation.
Show an exact proposed call, validated tool result and next model turn, plus a bounded stop after a failed call. Include application authority separate from the model proposal.
Give literal argument/result/error payloads with caller/resource IDs and stated side effect. Show schema-valid arguments denied because resource ownership differs.

An actual JSON-RPC session/cancel notification with a session ID is already shown. Preserve this concrete wire example; a negotiated session sequence would deepen capability/resume teaching without claiming this snippet has no input.
Show capability discovery, a concrete tools/call request and typed result, then the host authorization decision. Distinguish an advertised tool from permission to execute it.
Show a fictional task, artifact revision and reviewer decision with a stale-revision rejection. Use verified current protocol schema if showing wire fields; do not invent CHAP field names.
Supply a caller with Retail scope, Business resource ID, concrete allow/deny decision and proof no retrieval/effect occurred. A UI confirmation should not change that outcome.
Show attempt numbers and fixed example delay/deadline, acknowledgement loss after a stored referral, then a retry returning the same ID. Contrast non-retryable denial.
Show exact operation key, referral body, stored result ID, replay response and conflict for changed body. The mechanism is currently described without the state/values a reader could test.
Show request r1 cancelled, r2 created, then r1 result/approval arriving and being rejected. Include a completed external effect reported as completed rather than undone.
Provide the untrusted instruction text and attempted unauthorized action, then the application denial and unchanged effect count. Generic warnings do not demonstrate the trust boundary.

Show a small named-node state transition and interrupt/resume record, with an already-completed side effect on replay. Any library-specific API example needs a verified version; conceptual records must be labelled illustrative.
Show a document ID, retrieved node/source relation and resulting answer citation through a small query workflow. Include a provenance-loss failure rather than linking generic retrieval advice only.
Show literal safe span records with request/parent IDs, source revision and error category. Include the raw question omitted from trace and demonstrate locating a retrieval error.
Runtime-tested in-memory exporter code emits a retrieve span with example.result_count=2 and asserts the captured attributes. Concrete local input/output already exists; preserve it.
Give an explicit latency/event sample and alert threshold, show which window triggers, and name the owner/action. Contrast a satisfactory average with a slow tail.

Compute good/eligible rate and remaining bad-event budget from actual fictional counts, target and window. Show how excluding failed requests corrupts the denominator; the formula alone is not worked.
Give a synthetic alert, affected release IDs, containment action and concise incident timeline with preserved evidence IDs. Distinguish rollback action from root-cause conclusion.
Show before/after release manifests for code, prompt, model and index, then a restored lookup result. Include a stale cache or completed external write that code rollback does not undo.

Show a fictional trace-to-dataset-to-evaluation record with actual IDs, reviewed label and scored result. Explain a score dispute through the visible rubric; avoid pretending a generic trace example demonstrates this tool's workflow.

Show two experiment runs with concrete parameter, dataset/artifact versions and result records. Identify an invalid comparison when the datasets differ; use verified APIs only if presenting runnable code.
Show one common case and explicit expected assertion, then a case-level pass/fail report. Distinguish tool responsibilities with that case instead of only listing vendor names.

Show a labelled fictional serving benchmark with prompt/output sizes, concurrency and latency/throughput. Include overload or authentication boundary failure; avoid unverified flags or claimed hardware measurements.
Show a compatible artifact identifier, loopback endpoint and a concrete request/response, with a network-bind failure example. Verify any command flags against the selected release.
Show explicit local server URL, model revision/tag resolution and request/response payload. Contrast an alternate configured host to explain why installed locally does not prove execution locality.
Runtime-tested calculation maps 8B parameters at 4 bits to 4 GB of ideal weights only. It correctly excludes runtime memory; add workload evidence later without discarding this concrete calculation.

Show a toy quantization/dequantization value or explicitly illustrative same-task before/after artifact comparison with memory and task outcomes. Precision labels alone currently have no concrete transformation.

Show a task signature, one training example, metric decision and candidate output before/after optimization. Ensure held-out IDs are absent from optimization; tool capability nouns are not a worked program.

The illustrative code references undefined task_metric, program and train_cases and shows no candidate or result. Replace it or pair it with concrete definitions, before/after prompt text and untouched-case output; retain its illustrative status unless executed.
Show one training input/target record and which tokens contribute loss, then a held-out prompt and before/after output. Clarify synthetic examples are not measured training gains.

Give a base revision, adapter ID, trainable versus frozen parameter counts and load compatibility outcome. Show rejection for a different base; generic smaller-subset language leaves the artifact relationship invisible.
Provide small actual W,A,B matrices with rank r, multiply B by A and show W plus the update. Count trainable adapter parameters and distinguish the toy arithmetic from quality evidence.
Show a few records with source permission, labels including null/unknown and conversation-group IDs. Produce the grouped train/validation/test allocation without converting unknown to negative.
Show a seed record, generated candidate, independent source check and accepted/rejected labels. Include a held-out near-duplicate rejected for contamination.
Provide an actual illustrative release manifest tying model/tokenizer/prompt/index/adapter/evaluator IDs together. Show a missing-index or mutable-tag change that prevents a valid comparison.

Show a small pipeline with concrete document input, retriever output IDs and generator answer; then inspect a wrong-source success. Label framework APIs/version if used rather than mapping a generic retrieval paragraph.

Use an actual qualified policy sentence and two answers with equal citation success but different eligibility correctness. Show proxy score versus user-task verdict so the missing construct is visible.
Show before/after counts for answer rate and correctly resolved/referral outcomes. Demonstrate a rewarded answer-rate increase with more unsupported answers rather than only asserting the incentive.
100 eligible,80 answered,8 wrong yields 80% coverage/10% error;60 answered,3 wrong yields60%/5% with explicit referral change. Concrete tradeoff and zero-denominator limits already exist.
Write an actual fictional user journey, event definition, counted window, target and owner response. Distinguish HTTP arrival, correct answer and completed task with separate observed results.
100 cost units divided by20 verified outcomes equals5, with explicit undefined zero-success case and scoped cost boundary. Preserve concrete arithmetic; a cost-item breakdown would deepen it.
